release: Wanted & Interactive Search Trait Coherency Fix
name: Wanted & Interactive Search Trait Coherency Fix
changes: Makes Wanted, Library/Calendar cutoff state, Interactive Search, automatic selection, and upgrade preflight resolve the current library file through one canonical release-trait source.
Preserves the established current-file evidence precedence: stored release_traits, then fingerprint-bound original release title, then conservative media_info, then the stored base quality.

Fixes the v3.6.84 contradiction where Wanted could see a file as Dolby Vision-only while Interactive Search saw the same fingerprinted file as Dolby Vision + HDR fallback and rejected a matching candidate as same quality tier.
If the current file is already Dolby Vision + HDR fallback, it no longer remains in Wanted solely because a weaker media probe omitted HDR fallback metadata.

If the current file is truly Dolby Vision-only, Wanted continues to request the preferred Dolby Vision + HDR fallback upgrade and a matching DV+HDR candidate is accepted as a dynamic-range improvement.
Carries the v3.6.84 Allow-versus-Prefer cutoff semantics, accurate Wanted reason labels, 1080p Balanced behavior, and 4K preferred dynamic-range progression forward unchanged.
Preserves v3.6.83 installed/runtime/UI update-version coherency and the guarded source commit -> annotated tag -> separate trigger commit release topology.
Preserves frozen Newsgroup Browser tuning, SABnzbd 5.1.2, Smart Import/post-processing, Metadata Server v0.3.3, Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31 and the Defender-clean yEnc pipeline.
regression_guards: v3.6.85 pins the reviewed application payload and executes both sides of the exact v3.6.84 Wanted-versus-Interactive-Search trait disagreement.
A fingerprint cache release title identifying DV+HDR must be used consistently by Wanted and Interactive Search even when media_info only reports Dolby Vision.
A true Dolby Vision-only current file must remain upgradeable to Dolby Vision + HDR fallback and the candidate must not be rejected as same quality tier.
An already-terminal Dolby Vision + HDR fallback file must not remain in Wanted as a preferred dynamic-range upgrade.
v3.6.84 Allow-only dynamic-range policies remain acceptable rather than mandatory upgrade targets, while Prefer/Require continues to drive intended 4K progression.
Generic WEB to explicit WEB-DL source upgrades and base-quality cutoff behavior remain unchanged.
v3.6.83 same-version update protection and installed/runtime/UI version coherency remain guarded.
The canonical Source commit parser, immutable tag topology, frozen browser values, SABnzbd 5.1.2 and Defender-clean yEnc source/build identity remain unchanged.
